title: Retinal and cortical electrophysiological responses to instantaneous frequency shifts in light modulated above fusion.
abstract: Simultaneously recorded visual-evoked responses and electroretinograms are reported for a transient response produced by an abrupt change in the frequency of a light modulated above fusion. A principal components analysis was made of the recorded waveforms, and results of this analysis and their possible significance to clinical electrophysiology are discussed.
